label: Auction: real ADP + player status. The ADP sort now uses league-wide FantasyCalc dynasty values (every player, not just rookies) — Josh Allen ranks #1, and each card shows ADP + last-season points consistently. Players now carry a status: Won (by whom), Active (Bid), or Not Nominated when the auction's closed — with new status filters (Open / Active / Won). Bid History flags Forced increases (a franchise's proxy walked up) and by whom.
